units.source_text: 诸人皆极口赞誉源氏大将，或作和歌，或作汉诗。

en.t: Everyone praised General Genji to the skies; some composed waka, and others wrote Chinese poems.

units.source_text: 源氏大将得意之极，骄矜起来，朗诵“我文王之子，武王之弟……”

en.t: General Genji, at the height of his pride and satisfaction, grew arrogant and recited aloud, "I am the son of King Wen, the younger brother of King Wu..."
This comparison of himself was in fact quite fitting.

units.source_text: 但他是成王的何人，没有继续诵下去，因为只有这一点是疚心的。

en.t: But he did not go on to recite what relation he was to King Cheng, because that one point alone troubled his conscience.
